description.text: This major aims at encouraging the students’ all-round development of morality, intelligence and physique, cultivating their understanding of natural science, humanities and social science, raising their knowledge of basic computer science theory, software engineering and applications, and developing their capability of software development, their preliminary experiences in software implementation as well as project planning and organization. The senior application-oriented personnel can be engaged in software engineering research, software design and developing, software project management and service. Main Courses Object-Oriented Programming, Database Principle and Application, Data Structure and Algorithm, Software Engineering, Computer Network, Operating System, Computer Organization and Structure, UML and Design Pattern, Software Quality Assurance and Testing, Open GL programming, Software Components and Middleware, Web Programming, Cloud Computing and Distributed System, Embedded Operating System, Embedded System Design, Computer Animation Design and Production, Digital Audio/Video Coding Technology, Parallel Computing, Massive Information Processing and Computing, Software Testing Technology, etc.

duration.text: The Software Engineering at Changchun University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application form. 2. A copy of a valid passport, including name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. 3. A photo consistent with the passport of the applicant. 4. A copy of high school graduation certificate: A notarized copy is also required if it is in a text other than Chinese or English. 5. High school transcript. 6. Certificate for English proficiency , such as IELTS or TOEFL scores, only for Non-English native speakers. 7. A copy of visa: Only for students who are already in China. 8. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit relevant legal documents from their legal guardians in China.. 9. A copy of the Physical Examination Form for Foreigners within its validity period of 6 months . 10. A certificate of no criminal record within its validity period of 6 months. 11. A life photo of the full body taken within 3 months and a full-body video in 10 seconds. 12. Talents in art, sports, and other fields are preferred. Please provide certificates or performance videos.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese Citizen, in good health and under the age of 30. 2. High school diploma or above. 3. Applicants from non-native English speaking must have IELTS 5.5, TOEFL (IBT) 72 or above, or pass the English test organized by the school (the test time is approximately June 2023, and the specific time will be notified separately)
